name: application-code-editor-block
title: Code Editor Block
description: Syntax-highlighted code panel with line numbers, a gutter, an active-line highlight, and a file-tab or file-name header — richer editor chrome than a plain terminal block.
useWhen: Displaying a code sample that needs line numbers or a highlighted current/relevant line.
Showing more than one related file via a tab bar above the code panel.
Documentation or a changelog needs a copy-to-clipboard affordance next to a code sample.
avoidWhen: The sample is a single shell command — use application-terminal-blocks instead, it is simpler and prompt-styled.
The content must be actually editable by the user — this is a display-only block, not a live editor.
Real syntax highlighting across many languages is required — this component supplies the chrome only; pass your own tokenized spans or wire in a highlighter.
responsiveBehavior: The panel has a fixed max width and the code scrolls horizontally inside its own overflow-x-auto container so long lines never widen the page.
accessibility: The code panel carries an aria-label stating the language and file name, since syntax color alone does not convey that to assistive tech.
Line numbers are marked select-none so copying code doesn't include them in the clipboard text.
The active-line highlight uses both a background tint and gutter number color change, not color alone.

variants.title: File tabs
variants.description: Code panel with a multi-file tab bar, line numbers, and an active-line highlight, for showing one file among several related ones.
accessibility: The pre element carries an aria-label naming the language and active file.

variants.title: File tabs (Dark)
variants.description: File-tab code panel adapted for a dark page surface.
accessibility: The card border and surrounding chrome must remain visible against a dark page background.

variants.title: File name with copy action
variants.description: Code panel with a file-name header, a language icon, and a copy-to-clipboard button, for a single standalone code sample.
accessibility: The copy button carries visible text, not just an icon, so its purpose does not depend on the icon alone.

variants.title: File name with copy action (Dark)
variants.description: File-name code panel with a copy action, adapted for a dark page surface.
accessibility: The copy button's hover and focus states must remain visible against the dark header.
